title: Softmax function
prompt: Derive the Jacobian of the **Softmax function** $\frac{\partial S_i}{\partial z_j} = S_i (\delta_{ij} - S_j)$ and combine it with Categorical Cross-Entropy to show $\frac{\partial \mathcal{L}}{\partial z_i} = S_i - y_i$.
